body: Filed on 2026-09-23 by decision 0373 item 16 (V1-0011 stays open; the three Core ledger rows are `experimental`, every claim UNPROVEN). benchmarks/daily-loop-v0/runs/run-001.json records FAIL for UC-CHANGE-CONSEQUENCE on five treatment-only critical misses, all changed packages without tests: the consequence packet dropped them instead of naming them as unknown scope, which violates invariant 2 (missing evidence produces uncertainty, never silence).
